fact_text: The State Bank raised its policy rate from 10.5% to 11.5%, as reported in the 21 May 2026 flash.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Policy Rate at 11.5% | T-Bill Yields Above 13% | Oil Sentiment | Midday Flash 21 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-21)

fact_text: The State Bank mopped up about PKR 702 billion of treasury bills on 20 May 2026, pushing yields above 13%.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Policy Rate at 11.5% | T-Bill Yields Above 13% | Oil Sentiment | Midday Flash 21 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-21)

fact_text: Sitara Petroleum Services' IPO drew about PKR 70 billion of applications against an offer of roughly PKR 7 to 8 billion, showing liquidity in the market.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Policy Rate at 11.5% | T-Bill Yields Above 13% | Oil Sentiment | Midday Flash 21 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-21)

fact_text: Pakistan is to take about USD 1.2 billion of oil under an agreement with Saudi Arabia, which the analyst said is good for domestic refineries.

fact_text: Lucky Motor is introducing about four EV and SUV variants, reportedly from a Chinese partner, into the Pakistan market.

fact_text: Lucky Cement is the largest cement player by consumption, and the analyst saw its sales and exports as improving over nine months, which he considered favourable.

fact_text: Public sector development programme funds are being released, which the analyst said could support cement demand ahead of the budget expected around 5 June 2026.

fact_text: The analyst viewed banks with price-to-book below 1 as attractive value, and named Habib Bank (HBL) and Faysal Bank among those under closer watch.

fact_text: Higher policy and bill yields can let banks earn better spreads on lending as they grow their loan books, the analyst said.
